_about: Public-domain Cardinal Giovanni Bona (1609-1674), Cistercian liturgist and spiritual writer, for the Word Hoard: A Guide to Heaven (1672), Manuductio ad Coelum (1672), A Guide to Eternity in Roger L'Estrange's translation (second edition, 1676), Precepts and Practical Rules for a truly Christian Life (1678) and The Easy Way to God translated by Henry Collins (1876), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 37 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

bona-guide-heaven-1672: A Guide to Heaven, containing the marrow of the Holy Fathers and Antient Philosophers, in English by a Benedictine monk (printed in the year 1672)
bona-manuductio-1672: Manuductio ad Coelum: or, A Guide to Eternity (London: A. C. for Henry Brome, 1672)
bona-guide-eternity-1676: A Guide to Eternity, the second edition, by Roger L'Estrange (London: for Henry Brome, 1676)
bona-precepts-1678: Precepts and Practical Rules for a truly Christian Life, Englished by L. B. (London: M. Clark for H. Brome, M.DC.LXXVIII)
bona-easy-way-1876: The Easy Way to God: A Manual of Ejaculatory Prayer, tr. Henry Collins (London: R. Washbourne, 1876)

_alternates.bona-copies: A Moral Essay upon Friendship (1702, translator not named); Methuen's Guide to Eternity with Stanbridge's notes (title page year not read); later printings of the Guide to Eternity (1680-1722, not read)

_excluded.bona-other: A Treatise of Spiritual Life (1893, 1901): the title page shows it is Morozzo's, not Bona's
